title: MOM Strategy — Top-500 Domestic, FCF>0%
description: Momentum (6m1m) backtest results. Universe: top-500 domestic stocks by market cap, positive FCF. Weekly Friday rebalance (drift-hold between rebals), N=10. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +15.1%, IR 0.547, MaxDD -60.0%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +41.6%, IR 1.065, MaxDD -40.8%. Fixed: holiday Fridays (e.g. Good Friday) now correctly snap the rebalance back to Thursday instead of silently skipping that week's rebalance entirely.

title: LV Strategy — Top-600 Domestic, FCF>5%
description: Low Volatility backtest results. Universe: top-600 domestic stocks by market cap, FCF yield >5%. Weekly Friday rebalance (drift-hold between rebals), N=10, 60d vol signal. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +12.2%, IR 0.973, MaxDD -32.0%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +10.7%, IR 0.900, MaxDD -12.5%. Fixed: holiday Fridays (e.g. Good Friday) now correctly snap the rebalance back to Thursday instead of silently skipping that week's rebalance entirely.

title: MR Strategy — FCF Top-200, 10 Most Oversold
description: Mean Reversion backtest results. Universe: top-1500 domestic, FCF>2%, net debt <=1x, vol >=. Stage-1: top-200 by FCF yield. Stage-2: 10 most oversold. Daily rebalance. IS 2001-2021: CAGR +28.5%, IR 0.724, MaxDD -75.1%. OOS 2022-2026: CAGR +12.9%, IR 0.370, MaxDD -37.6%. Now includes signal_70d_return (the actual stage-2 oversold-ranking signal) as its own column, alongside fcf_yield (stage-1 ranking signal) - previously only fcf_yield was output since our CSV logic only auto-included the primary strategy signal, not the secondary-sort signal actually used to pick the 10 stocks.

title: MOM Strategy — Our Mani-Spec Reproduction (IS+OOS, 2001-2026)
description: Our reproduction of Mani's disclosed MOM spec (N=500, highest mom_6m1m signal, weekly Friday rebalance, positive FCF required, no net-debt cap, $5M DV floor, min_price>=$2 entry), run after the market-cap anchor fix and IS/OOS continuity fix (one continuous backtest, not two cold-started runs). Shown here: full IS 2001-2021 + OOS 2022-2026 holdings and daily returns in one file. Our IS CAGR +14.8%, OOS CAGR +44.4%, OOS MaxDD -40.8% (near-exact match) vs. Mani's published IS CAGR +15.4%, OOS CAGR +42.4%, OOS MaxDD -40.78%. Compare directly against Mani's mom_500_fcf0_final_pit_2026-07-02.csv above.

title: LV Strategy — Our Mani-Spec Reproduction (IS+OOS, 2001-2026)
description: Our reproduction of Mani's disclosed LV spec (N=600, lowest 60d realized-vol signal, monthly last-Friday rebalance [corrected mid-reconciliation after finding his published header said weekly but his actual run rebalances monthly], FCF>=5%, no net-debt cap, $5M DV floor, min_price>=$2 entry), run after the market-cap anchor fix and IS/OOS continuity fix (one continuous backtest, not two cold-started runs). Shown here: full IS 2001-2021 + OOS 2022-2026 holdings and daily returns in one file. Our IS CAGR +11.6%, OOS CAGR +13.4% vs. Mani's published IS CAGR +12.0%, OOS CAGR +10.4%. Compare directly against Mani's lv_600_fcf5_final_pit_2026-07-02.csv above.

title: MR Strategy — Our Mani-Spec Reproduction (IS+OOS, 2001-2026)
description: Our reproduction of Mani's disclosed MR spec (N=1500, Stage-1 top-200 FCF yield, Stage-2 10 most oversold on 70d return, FCF>=2%, net debt<=1x, $20M DV floor, min_price>=$2 entry / $0.50 exit, daily rebalance), run against our master_prices_computed after the market-cap anchor fix and IS/OOS continuity fix (one continuous backtest, not two cold-started runs). Shown here: full IS 2001-2021 + OOS 2022-2026 holdings and daily returns in one file. Our IS CAGR +29.7%, OOS CAGR +14.3% vs. Mani's published IS CAGR +28.5%, OOS CAGR +12.9%. Compare directly against Mani's mr_fcf200_mr10_vol20_final_pit_2026-07-02.csv above.
